integrity: The proof is reconstructed directly from the published EBSH CDF and density. The source's full open-access PDF was inspected at the defining formulas and at its explicit light-tail discussion. The parent BSH full text and a standard heavy-tail definition were also compared. Numerical checks are supplementary and do not establish the infinite-domain results.
scientific_limitations: The result is a terminal asymptotic classification and does not classify the full finite-range hazard shape.
Heavy-tail terminology varies across applied fields; the exact survival and MGF statements are the definition-independent content.
No second-order tail expansion is asserted, and theta can materially affect finite-threshold behavior.
title: EBSH has a sharp heavy-tail phase at alpha equals one
